$comment: GENERATED by `npm run gen:contracts` from the catalogue, the recipe, spec/figma-components.json and the repo. Never edit by hand.
label: Split Bar
description: A single bar that is 100 % of something, cut into shares (SplitBarSegment) over a legend (SplitBarLegendItem) that turns each series on and off. The bar clips its segments to Radius/action; the legend wraps on Spacing/gap-group.

props.name: segments
props.type: { id: string; label: string; value: number; series: 1–8 }[]
props.description: The shares. `value` is any non-negative number; the bar shows each as its share of what is shown.

props.name: aria-label / aria-labelledby
props.description: The chart's title: the bar is a role="group" named by it (one of the two is required).

props.name: valueUnit
props.description: Unit of `value` for the screen reader: "Organic search, 41.6%, 41,300 sessions".

props.name: hiddenIds / defaultHiddenIds / onHiddenIdsChange
props.description: The series that are turned off (controlled or not). The last series shown cannot be turned off.

props.name: leaderBelow
props.description: A share under this percent (default 5) keeps its text out of the bar: a callout with a leader line sits under it.

usage: Parts of one whole, up to eight: traffic by source, spend by team, storage by type. Colours are Chart/series-1…8 (categories with no meaning); when a share means good or bad, use Status/* instead. A share that is not part of a whole is a ProgressLine; a trend is a Sparkline. Related: SplitBarSegment, SplitBarLegendItem, ProgressLine.
accessibility: role="group" named by the chart title. Each segment is a button named "label, share, value unit"; each legend item an aria-pressed toggle. Tab visits segments then legend items; Enter or Space presses. Colour is never the only divider: every segment has a Chart/series-n/solid edge.
